name: Cable Single-Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Face a low pulley and hold its handle overhand beside your thigh.
Bend your elbow to lift the handle while keeping your knuckles on top.
Straighten your elbow slowly to return the handle.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep the back of your hand aligned with your forearm.
Keep your working elbow tucked beside your ribs without leaning back.
